description.value: Misty River Lodge is a mountain lodge and guest house at the gateway to the Columbia Valley in Radium Hot Springs, BC, framed by the Purcell and Rocky Mountain ranges. It offers several distinct suite types — including a glamping family suite sleeping up to six, a cross suite, and a whitetail suite — each with private bathrooms and varying kitchenette configurations. A shared full kitchen stocked with pots, pans, and utensils is available to all guests, making it a practical base for self-sufficient travelers exploring the Kootenays.

address.value: 5036 Banff-Windermere Parkway, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and confirms Misty River Lodge is an active mountain lodge in Radium Hot Springs offering multiple suite types and a shared full kitchen for all guests. No bike-specific amenities — secure storage, tools, laundry, drying area, e-bike charging, or Wi-Fi — are mentioned anywhere across the five fetched pages; both required criteria are therefore unconfirmed. There is an email address discrepancy between OSM (office@mistyriverlodge.ca) and the website (office@mistyriverlodge.com), and the street name differs between OSM ('Banff-Windermere Parkway') and the website contact page ('Highway 93'), though both names refer to the same road.
